notes.title: Added Inventory Viewer and a Nice Background!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that, [b]just a week after launch[/b], we're adding an inventory viewer for skin selection and updating the UI!

The inventory viewer is pretty straightforward, but let's talk about the background update. At a high level, we want Coconut to evolve into much more than just another "afk skin game." Our vision includes a variety of engaging features and more activities for you to "do" or work towards in-game. As we plan and implement these more complex gameplay elements, we'll also be incrementally adding quality-of-life improvements - starting with this nicer background, better icons (coming soon), and much more that you'll see in future update logs!

We look forward to rapidly improving Coconut beyond most competitors, thanks to our unique approach to development and community engagement.

[b]Enjoy the update, and don't hesitate to reach out on Discord if you encounter any issues with the new features![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 5th: Multithreading!
notes.content:
In order to make sure that everything runs properly even when the game is fully minimized, the drop checking has been moved to a secondary thread, but animations and interface still happens in the main thread. When the game is minimized the main thread freezes, and only the absolute minimum code runs (checking for drops every 2h), meaning that the game is better in two ways:

[olist]
[*] Uses even less CPU than it already did when minimized
[*] Drops are more reliable when the game is minimized for long periods of time (i.e. for multiple drop periods).
[/olist]

We also fixed a few smaller bugs, so thanks to everyone who keeps reaching out to let me know about them.

Big features are in the works, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Fix skin drop bug affecting small number of players, plus add a settings interfa
notes.content:
The biggest change for gameplay in this patch was updating how the game requests skins. This update should hopefully resolve a handful of complaints that players didn't receive a skin after the countdown. Thanks to those who reached out to let us know about this issue.

Additionally a settings interface has been added, including a "promo code" system which we will use in the future for discord-based giveaways.

Finally, we added better error screens, so now if something goes wrong it will pop up a visible error message with a purple background indicating the issue and possible fixes, as well as directions to contact us in the event of a persisting issue.

Looking forward to what you all think!

notes.title: Achievements and Icons!
notes.content:
Regular update, we added a few things including achievements for:
[list]
[*] Opening the game
[*] Getting first 30s drop
[*] Getting first 2h drop
[*] Owning one of each rarity
[*] Receiving a legendary coconut from a drop (buying one doesn't count towards this achievement)
[/list]

Also we added icons to the game as it appears in the taskbar, task manager, window icon, etc.

Finally, we fixed a few minor bugs including:

[list]
[*] Fixed crashing on launch if the game was fully removed and then reinstalled
[*] Fixed minor text display bug that happens only on some resolutions
[/list]
